content: अपत्त्र {%a.%} Leafless, without wings <ab>&c.</ab> .{@-त्त्रः@} .²1 The shoot of bamboo; a sprout in general (तदवस्थायां तयोः पत्रशून्यतयोत्पत्तेस्तथात्वम्). .²2 A tree the leaves of which have fallen off. .²3 A bird without wings. .{@-त्त्रा@} <ab>N.</ab> of a plant (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>नेबती</ns>).
